values.meaning: bonus physical damage from Harrier against monsters
duration a Harrier mark lasts (and target is revealed)
values.quote: mark enemies hit with ''Harrier'' for 4 seconds, during which they are {{tip|standard sight|revealed}}

mechanics.claim: Quinn's basic attacks on-hit against a Harrier-marked target consume the mark to deal bonus physical damage.
mechanics.quote: '''Quinn's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} against ''Harrier'' targets are empowered to consume the mark to deal {{pp|15 + (120-15)/17*(x-1) for 20|color=physical damage}} {{as|(+ 40% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}.

mechanics.claim: Harrier is consumed by the empowered attack even if that attack is parried/negated.
mechanics.quote: ''Harrier'' is consumed even if it is parried, the attack is negated in any case.

mechanics.claim: Blinding Assault, Vault, and Skystrike apply the Harrier mark to enemies they hit, which is a separate proc from the on-hit consume damage.
mechanics.quote: '''Quinn's''' ''{{ai|Blinding Assault|Quinn}}'' against the primary target, ''{{ai|Vault|Quinn}}'', and ''{{ai|Skystrike|Quinn}}'' mark enemies hit with ''Harrier''

mechanics.claim: While Behind Enemy Lines (R) is active, Harrier is disabled and all marks are removed, preventing the on-hit consume damage.
mechanics.quote: While ''{{ai|Behind Enemy Lines|Quinn}}'' is active, ''Harrier'' is disabled and all ''Harrier'' marks are removed.

mechanics.claim: If a mark is overwritten, consumed, or times out, Harrier goes on a 1-second cooldown before it can be reapplied.
mechanics.quote: If a mark applied by an ability is overwritten, consumed, or timed out, ''Harrier'' goes on a 1-second cooldown if it's not already on cooldown.
